The high per capita fecundity is consistent with a life-history strategy that depends on broad larval dispersal across heterogeneous reef habitats, with the potential for long-distance colonization of available settlement sites.

After metamorphosis and settlement into juvenile habitats over sandy bottoms, the young-of-year experience a phase of rapid mass gain as they transition to a diet of small benthic crustaceans and polychaetes.
